scope: ADR-0026 step 4 focused core only: publish the exact authenticated fd4 predecessor envelope under its registry-lab digest name while preserving the initializing marker, leaving HEAD absent, and returning discard-required

accepted_core_contract.compatibility_controls: L05w, L05x, and L05y stop at their original barriers and leave every L05z fact, scalar, digest, and basename byte zero
accepted_core_contract.locked_state: original predecessor bytes, dedicated readback, and placement-owned credential remain in the mlocked secure_inputs mapping; the facts-only verifier avoids a returned raw-envelope carrier
accepted_core_contract.identity: the registry-lab SHA-256 domain names the exact authenticated fd4 bytes as e-<64 lowercase hexadecimal>.cbor; launcher pins, exact length, EOF, bytes, and digest are checked at each readback

accepted_core_contract.publication: close the writable marker descriptor before step 4; exclusively create initialize-envelope.tmp; validate, write, read, authenticate, and fsync it; immediately reopen and revalidate it read-only; rename with RENAME_NOREPLACE; fsync envelopes then staging
accepted_core_contract.final_barrier: the final object is bound to the pinned temporary inode and exact bytes/authentication; the unchanged marker is rechecked after final layout and envelope confirmation before qualification; HEAD is absent and attempts/staging are empty
accepted_core_contract.failure_authority: all post-latch errors and ambiguities remain whole-root discard-required; no retry of ambiguous publication, adoption, repair, unlink, truncate, or per-entry cleanup is admitted
accepted_core_contract.cleanup: all non-lock descriptors close before credential destruction and locked mapping wipe/unlock/unmap; writer and fixture locks remain held until inherited cleanup completes
